title.narrative: Ukraine MultiPartner Trust Fund for Peacebuilding and Recovery

description.narrative:
"The objective of the Trust Fund is to help meet the socio-economic needs of conflict-affected populationsâ€”including but not limited to Internally Displaced Populations (IDPs)comma returneescomma former combatantscomma and host communitiesâ€” in Ukraine.
Within the context of the broader Multi-Partner efforts for Recovery and Peacebuilding in Ukraine comma the Bank MPTF is expected to capitalize on the comparative advantagescomma experiences and operational modalities of the Bank and the UNcomma respectivelycomma for implementation of activities behind a country-led strategy for recovery and peacebuilding. Both MPTFs will support priorities as identified in the forthcoming Government of Ukraine led State Target Program for Peacebuilding in the Eastern Regions (STP).
The Bank MPTF aims to fill strategic funding gapscomma pilot activities that can be brought to scalecomma and provide capacity buildingcomma technical assistance and analytic support. In the Ukraine contextcomma the Bank MPTF will seek to complement and leverage national investmentscomma lendingcomma and private sector engagement.
More specificallycomma the Bank MPTF will:
a) Support immediate peacebuildingcomma recovery and reconstruction interventions in the priority region of Eastern Ukraine including through a participatory approach with local and community-based consultations based on priorities identified in the RPA and STP.
b) Foster socio-economic recovery and stabilization by analyzing key constraints to economic development in Eastern Ukrainecomma identifying potential drivers of growth to generate employment and public supportcomma and supporting building blocks of large public investment programs.
c) Enable better data gatheringcomma information-sharing and collaboration among development actors.
d) Implement a monitoring system to provide regular and reliable data on socio-economic impacts of conflict and displacement and to track impacts of programming of the MPTF.
e) Build citizen trust by supporting national outreach and communications to promote national reconciliationcomma transparency and information sharing with eastern populations of Ukraine.
f) Provide direct support for local community resilience and the decentralization agendacomma including through capacity building support and recovery planning for amalgamated communities.
g) Build capacity of national/regional/local GoU institutions for sustainable recovery efforts based on strong national ownership among nationalcomma regional and local stakeholders.
h) Bridge the humanitarian-development divide through a holistic and longer-term perspective on conflict management that links humanitarian and development responses."
